mismatch.message: unsupported hero command: an unported branch of this command: discovery display requires choose_disco_sort()

summary: The menu-prefixed known command reaches the existing dodiscovered caller, which stops at its explicit choose_disco_sort() refusal before drawing the ordering menu. Upstream o_init.c:choose_disco_sort owns this menu and updates flags.discosort after selection; this source helper is the first owner. The same-file rename_disco() function owned by B builds a separate menu of nameable object types.

source.branch: For the menu-prefixed backslash known command, dodiscovered() calls choose_disco_sort(1) when iflags.menu_requested is true. choose_disco_sort displays the four ordering choices, preserves the currently selected flags.discosort entry, updates flags.discosort from a selection, and returns the number of selected menu items; dodiscovered() returns ECMD_OK when the result is negative and otherwise continues discovery display.
callers: o_init.c:dodiscovered() calls choose_disco_sort(1) at lines 777-780; JavaScript already wires the known key through js/cmd.js:runKnownCommand() to js/o_init.js:dodiscovered().
o_init.c:doclassdisco() calls choose_disco_sort(2) at lines 912-914; this C-only caller remains blocked because JavaScript has no doclassdisco() implementation or runKnownClassCommand() dispatcher.

options.c:optfn_sortdiscoveries() calls choose_disco_sort(0) at lines 3890-3892 and discards the return; the JavaScript option inventory marks sortdiscoveries as having a handler, but js/options.js has no sortdiscoveries entry in OPTION_HANDLERS.
dependencies: windows.c:add_menu(), end_menu(), select_menu(), and destroy_nhwindow() are represented by js/windows.js:select_menu() and js/tty_menu.js.
Only mode 1 is verified by the admitted v48 recording. The independent mode 0 and mode 2 recipes are retained as blockers, not runtime evidence.

evidence: Fresh scan /tmp/c-v48-discovery-sort-before.json at source baseline 36b5538f291298898d1cc981f7c94056723f6765 reproduces the UnsupportedDiscoveryDisplayError at step 2 after 2 of 4 screens; all 2,621 RNG calls match.

nethack-c/upstream/src/o_init.c:611-655 contains choose_disco_sort(); lines 777-780 call it in dodiscovered() when iflags.menu_requested is set and consume the return value. The user selects the ordering menu item before the command continues.

js/o_init.js:dodiscovered() currently throws UnsupportedDiscoveryDisplayError("choose_disco_sort()") when menu_requested is true. js/cmd.js:runKnownCommand() already routes the direct known command to this existing function.
This is separate from B’s o_init.c:rename_disco() scope: rename_disco builds a menu of nameable object types, while choose_disco_sort builds the discovery-order menu and changes flags.discosort.

coverageDecision.implemented: Complete choose_disco_sort() and wire its active JavaScript dodiscovered() mode 1 caller. Do not claim whole dodiscovered() completion because sorted output orders still reach unported disco_output_sorted() helpers.

blockedCallers.blocker: js/options.js has no OPTION_HANDLERS sortdiscoveries mapping or handler_sortdiscoveries() implementation.
The JavaScript knownclass command has no doclassdisco() implementation or production dispatcher.
